meeting.bibleReading: An Appeal on the Basis of Love

material.title: Weekend companion outline
material.introduction: Follow the public talk and the study at your own pace. Read the official material in JW Library.

sections.heading: Begin together
sections.body: Listen to the song and settle in at your own pace.

sections.heading: Public talk
sections.body: Listen for one helpful idea. The talk topic is chosen by your congregation.

sections.heading: An Appeal on the Basis of Love
sections.body: Follow the study in JW Library. Keep a word, a sketch or a personal thought here.

sections.heading: Take a thought with you
sections.body: You can return to your notes or drawing whenever you want.

parts.title: Opening song and prayer
parts.summary: Which words in the song stand out to you?

activities.title: A thought to keep
activities.prompt: Which words in the song stand out to you?

mission.title: A thought to keep
mission.listeningObjective: Which words in the song stand out to you?
clues: Notice a word you hear in the song.
Does the song remind you of something from the meeting?
Keep it as a word, a drawing or a question. Listening is enough too.

parts.title: Public talk
parts.summary: Listen for one helpful idea or scripture. You can draw or write what you notice.

activities.title: One thought to keep
activities.prompt: Notice one idea you would like to remember from the talk.

mission.title: One thought to keep
mission.listeningObjective: Notice one idea you would like to remember from the talk.
clues: Listen for a word or idea that catches your attention.
Notice an example or scripture connected to that idea.
Draw it or keep it in your own words. You can also just listen.
